b1_mechanism: requestBufferForProcess captures Binder uid/pid before clearCallingIdentity, validates package ownership, and passes those captured values into the locked selection before restoring identity and returning.
b2_mechanism: fetchActiveBuffersLocked selects the current uid/pid buffer or creates its replacement; the exact selected ActiveBuffer is the object whose descriptor is obtained.
b3_mechanism: requestBufferForProcessLocked returns buffer.getPfd, which duplicates that ActiveBuffer SharedMemory descriptor.
b4_mechanism: The selected buffer PFD is duplicated and returned synchronously before the Binder response.
common_instrumentation_premise: Binder.execTransactInternal enter/exit/POP CDAC hook; exit after observer/trace callbacks in finally (A16/A17 and fixed A15)
